description: File a payment request in the user's MARU wallet. This does NOT pay. The user sees the amount and recipient in the MARU app and approves with Face ID or rejects. Use maru_wallet_request_status to see the outcome. Never tell the user a payment was made until the status is 'done'.

title.description: What this payment is for, in the user's language, max 80 characters

name: maru_wallet_request_payment
title: Ask the wallet owner to approve a payment
